func:
if (!msg.batchState || !msg.batchState.lotNo) {
    node.error("BATCH LotNo missing");
    return null;
}

var lotNo =
    String(msg.batchState.lotNo).trim();

var sendDate =
    String(
        (msg.autoBatch && msg.autoBatch.sendDate) ||
        msg.sendDate ||
        global.get("sendAllRejectDate") ||
        ""
    ).trim();

if (!sendDate) {
    node.error("BATCH DateDepallet missing for " + lotNo);
    return null;
}

var safeLot =
    lotNo.replace(/'/g, "''");

var safeDate =
    sendDate.replace(/'/g, "''");

msg.topic = `
WITH R AS
(
    SELECT
        LotDepID,
        DateDepallet,
        DateReject,
        dt,
        ShiftID,
        CuringCnt,
        ToPackCnt,
        Rej_R01,
        Rej_R02,
        Rej_R03,
        Rej_R04,
        Rej_R05,
        Rej_R06,
        Rej_R08,
        Rej_R12,
        Rej_R13,
        Rej_R99,
        RecTime
    FROM PIS_REJECT
    WHERE LotDepID = '${safeLot}'
      AND CAST(DateDepallet AS date) = '${safeDate}'
),
Latest AS
(
    SELECT TOP 1
        DateDepallet,
        DateReject,
        dt,
        ShiftID,
        RecTime
    FROM R
    ORDER BY dt DESC, RecTime DESC
)
SELECT
    MAX(R.LotDepID) AS LotDepID,

    L.DateDepallet,
    L.DateReject,
    L.dt,
    L.ShiftID,

    SUM(COALESCE(R.CuringCnt,0)) AS CuringCnt,
    SUM(COALESCE(R.ToPackCnt,0)) AS ToPackCnt,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R01,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R01 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R01,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R02,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R02 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R02,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R03,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R03 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R03,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R04,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R04 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R04,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R05,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R05 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R05,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R06,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R06 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R06,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R08,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R08 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R08,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R12,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R12 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R12,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R13,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R13 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R13,

    SUM(
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(R.Rej_R99,0) > 0
        THEN R.Rej_R99 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS Rej_R99,

    SUM(
        COALESCE(R.Rej_R99,0)
    ) AS Rej_R99_Raw,

    L.RecTime

FROM R
CROSS JOIN Latest L

GROUP BY
    L.DateDepallet,
    L.DateReject,
    L.dt,
    L.ShiftID,
    L.RecTime
`;

node.status({
    fill: "blue",
    shape: "dot",
    text: lotNo + " | " + sendDate
});

return msg;

name: Build ALL Header Query
func:
var productionDate = global.get("sendAllRejectDate");

if (!productionDate) {
    node.error("Please select Production Date before SEND ALL PROD");
    return null;
}

msg.productionDate = productionDate;

msg.topic = `
WITH CreateOrder AS (
    SELECT TRIM(lotNo) AS lotNo
    FROM (
        SELECT lotNo, IsSuccess,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lotNo ORDER BY RecTime DESC) AS rw
        FROM PIS_API_RESULT
        WHERE IsSuccess = 1 AND OutputDetailId IS NULL
    ) X
    WHERE rw = 1
)
SELECT
     P.[Prod Date] AS productionDate
    ,P.[Shift] AS shiftCode
    ,NULL AS operatorName
    ,NULL AS operationCode
    ,P.[Start Time] AS dateTimeStart
    ,P.[End Time] AS dateTimeEnd
    ,NULL AS remark_1
    ,P.[Plant] AS plantCode
    ,P.[Machine] AS Machine
    ,P.[PlanWeek] AS planWeek
    ,P.[PlanName] AS planName
    ,P.[VersionNo] AS versionNo
    ,P.followPlan AS followPlan
    ,P.[MaterialCode] AS materialCode
    ,TRIM(P.[Lot No.]) AS lotNo
    ,P.[CuringCnt] AS gross0
    ,NULL AS remark_2
FROM PIS_PRD_ORDER P
LEFT JOIN CreateOrder C ON TRIM(P.[Lot No.]) = C.lotNo
WHERE CAST(P.[Prod Date] AS date) = '${productionDate}'
  AND C.lotNo IS NULL
ORDER BY P.[Shift], P.[Start Time], P.[Lot No.]`;
return msg;

name: Check Lots
Prepare PIS_PRD_TIME
func:
var header = msg.payload;
if (!header || !header.lotNo) { node.error("Header/LotNo missing"); return null; }
msg.header = header;
function sqlEscape(v){ return String(v == null ? "" : v).replace(/'/g,"''"); }
var lotNo = sqlEscape(String(header.lotNo).trim());
msg.topic = `
SELECT
       [DateStr],[ShiftID],[LotProdID],[LotDepID],
       [DownTimeCode] AS downtimeCode,
       0 AS [continue],
       [PIS_TaskCode] AS taskCode,
       '' AS repairNo,
       [PIS_Cause] AS pisCause,
       [pPIS_StopCode],[pPIS_TaskCode],
       [StartTime] AS startDateTime,
       [EndTime] AS endDateTime,
       [Duration_min] AS duration,
       [Detail] AS cause,
       [Remark] AS remark,
       [MEO],
       [mc_code] AS equipmentCode,
       [mSubMc] AS serialNo,
       [CauseID] AS failureCode
FROM PIS_PRD_TIME
WHERE LotProdID = '${lotNo}'
ORDER BY StartTime`;
return msg;
